data.narrative:
Mammoth Biosciences is a Series D biotech company founded by Jennifer Doudna and others, having raised $600M+ to date. The valuation assessment draws on a peer universe of 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in the Biotech & Health sector, including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and New Limit.

Two valuation methods triangulate the target's value. Stage-Progression, using total raised as a proxy baseline and applying a typical 1.5x Series D step-up multiplier to the $600M raised, implies $900M. Peer-Median across the 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private comparables yields a median valuation of $3.8B (range: $3.1B–$10.3B). Public-Comp Anchoring is not applicable; while the Biotech & Health public median trades at 6.2x price-to-sales across 3 tickers, the target's revenue is not on file, precluding this method.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $765M (low) to $4.4B (high), with a median of $2.4B. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around the target's stage positioning relative to peers—some comparables remain in Series C—and the absence of revenue visibility. The $900M stage-progression result sits at the low end, while peer median anchors at the midpoint. Key uncertainties include actual clinical/commercial progress trajectory and whether the peer set adequately reflects Mammoth's competitive positioning within frontier biotech.
